name: @aleburato/primeval
description: TypeScript-first Node package for primeval image approximation.

scripts.prepare:package: npm run build && npm run generate:binding
scripts.build:node: napi build -p primeval-node --release --platform --no-js --dts binding.d.ts --output-dir . && npm run generate:binding
scripts.verify:rust: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo doc --no-deps --workspace && cargo test
scripts.verify:node: npm run lint && npm run check:napi-targets && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run build:node && npm test && npm run test:tooling
scripts.verify: npm run verify:rust && npm run verify:node && npm run verify:pack
scripts.test: node --test test/index.test.js test/contracts.test.js test/native.test.js test/cli.test.js test/readme.test.js test/types.test.js
